character: a praying mantis, green-brown, triangular head, huge amber eyes, spined arms in the prayer stance; an arm shoots out and snaps back; fussy about creases like a tidy packer
cast: one fat fly with a straw as a microphone, always huge at the lens, nearer than the mantis, never speaking; at the end it drops the straw and flies off alive. One foreign leg at the frame edge in the last beat is intended
props: one box: taped shut, slit open, empty, then shut over him from inside — it came not with goods but for goods. Bubble wrap: bulging out, shaken out, smoothed under him, popping. Tape: slit, flapping, pulled back over the seam. One label: no letters, only a pictogram of a female mantis silhouette, keep it
environment: a concrete doorstep in a warm empty evening yard
lighting: hard cyan rim left, warm amber kick right around the silhouette, deep shadows, high contrast

light_events.event: the falling box sweeps a shadow across his face
the warm kick dies, a wide shadow crosses the closed box

voice: male, low dry warm chest voice around 130 Hz, weary, deadpan, adult
lip_sync: he talks like a person: mouthparts open and close on every syllable, sharp articulation

audio.delivery: native Russian, weary deadpan, four and a half syllables per second
audio.pacing: a short pause after each sentence, endings voiced, nothing spoken after 6.0

speech_rule: he keeps working while he speaks: the mouth moves on every syllable and the arms go on handling the box

timeline.a: silent. A box lands before him, dust jumping; he does not flinch
even tempo, mouth on every syllable; he taps the lid twice, swings the box label-side to the fly, which pushes the straw at him
silent. An arm shoots out, slits the tape, snaps back
even tempo; the head turns 180 degrees on a still body, a claw taps the pictogram twice
silent. He throws both flaps open, wrap bulges out, the bottom is empty
even tempo, last word fully voiced; he tears a strip of wrap free and shakes it out over the empty bottom
silent from here on. He peels the label corner and smooths it back
he steps over the rim into the box
he pulls the wrap under him and smooths the crease
he pulls both flaps shut over himself
timeline.c: flaps swing shut at the lens

timeline.a: he drags the flapping strips over the seam, a bubble pops under him
a thin leg comes out of the last gap and presses the tape flat
the fly drops the straw and flies off alive
a foreign leg, larger than his, lands on the lid; the label faces us

negative_prompt: slow speech, drawn-out delivery, swallowed endings, voice over, subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, burned-in graphics, text on the label, English speech, foreign accent, static camera, floating objects, duplicate props, malformed anatomy, a whole second mantis in frame, the fly harmed, character changing appearance mid-shot
